criteria.name: GeM Registration
criteria.description: Seller must be registered on Government e-Marketplace (GeM) portal
criteria.source_clause: Vendor shall be registered on the GeM portal (gem.gov.in) and possess a valid Seller ID.

criteria.name: GST Registration
criteria.source_clause: Bidder must hold a valid GST Registration Certificate.

criteria.name: PAN Card
criteria.description: Permanent Account Number issued by Income Tax Department
criteria.source_clause: Copy of PAN Card of the firm/company is mandatory.

criteria.name: Average Annual Turnover
criteria.source_clause: Average Annual Turnover Certificate of Rs. 41.6 Lakh (Proforma as Appendix-C) on works during the last three financial years from a Chartered Accountant.

criteria.name: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD)
criteria.source_clause: EMD of Rs. 41,600/- (Rupees Forty One Thousand Six Hundred only) shall be deposited.

criteria.name: ISO 9001 Certification
criteria.description: Valid ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System certification
criteria.source_clause: The bidder shall hold a valid ISO 9001:2015 certification from an accredited body.

criteria.name: Solvency Certificate
criteria.source_clause: Solvency certificate from a Nationalised / Scheduled Bank for not less than Rs. 20,800/-.

criteria.name: Integrity Pact
criteria.description: Signed Integrity Pact between CRPF and the bidder
criteria.source_clause: All bidders shall sign and submit the Integrity Pact as per the prescribed format.

title: CRPF South Zone Hyderabad Major Works

criteria.name: Average Annual Turnover
criteria.source_clause: Average Annual Turnover of Rs. 75 Lakhs on civil works during the last three financial years, certified by a Chartered Accountant.

criteria.name: Experience in Similar Works
criteria.description: At least one similar work of value >= 50% of estimated cost in last 7 years
required_documents: Experience / Completion Certificates from Government Authority
criteria.source_clause: The bidder must have completed at least one similar work of value not less than 50% of the estimated cost in the last seven years.

criteria.name: ISO 9001 Certification
criteria.source_clause: Bidder shall hold valid ISO 9001:2015 certification.

criteria.name: Non-Blacklisting Affidavit
criteria.description: Self-declaration that bidder is not blacklisted by any Central/State Government
criteria.source_clause: Bidder shall submit a self-declaration on stamp paper stating not blacklisted by any Government entity.

criteria.name: Average Annual Turnover
criteria.source_clause: Average Annual Turnover Certificate of Rs. 52 Lakh for the last three financial years from a CA.

criteria.name: EMD
criteria.source_clause: EMD of Rs. 52,000/- to be deposited in favour of the Commandant.

criteria.name: ISO 9001 Certification
criteria.source_clause: Valid ISO 9001:2015 certification required.

criteria.name: DSC Class 3
criteria.description: Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate for e-tendering
criteria.source_clause: Bidder must possess a Class 3 DSC for signing and submitting bids on the e-procurement portal.

criteria.name: Annual Turnover
criteria.source_clause: The bidder should have average annual turnover of at least Rs. 5 Crore (Rs. 500 Lakhs) from IT related works/services during last three financial years.

criteria.name: ISO 9001 / ISO 27001 Certification
criteria.source_clause: The bidder shall possess valid ISO 9001:2015 or ISO 27001:2013 certification.

criteria.name: Past Experience
criteria.description: Minimum 3 years of experience in IT infrastructure supply/installation for Government
criteria.source_clause: Bidder should have at least 3 years experience in supply and installation of IT infrastructure for Government departments.

criteria.name: Annual Turnover
criteria.source_clause: Average annual turnover of Rs. 2 Crore for the last three years from IT products/services, certified by a CA.

criteria.name: Authorised Dealer Certificate
criteria.description: Manufacturer's authorisation for OEM products being supplied
criteria.source_clause: Bidder must be an authorised dealer/partner of the OEM for all IT products being supplied.

criteria.name: GST & PAN
criteria.source_clause: Valid GST registration and PAN are mandatory.

criteria.name: Registered Publisher / Authorised Distributor
criteria.description: Must be an authorised distributor of IEC and BIS standards
criteria.source_clause: The bidder shall be an authorised distributor of IEC and BIS standards in India.

criteria.name: EMD
criteria.source_clause: EMD of Rs. 5,000/- to be submitted along with the tender.

criteria.name: GST Registration
criteria.source_clause: Valid GST registration required.

criteria.name: Financial Eligibility — Annual Turnover
criteria.source_clause: The bidder should have had an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 1 Crore during the last three years, as evidenced by the audited annual accounts.

criteria.name: EMD (Bid Security)
criteria.description: Bid security as specified in the Bid Data Sheet
criteria.source_clause: The Bidder shall furnish, as part of its bid, a bid security as specified in the BDS.

criteria.name: Technical Experience
criteria.description: Prior supply of similar goods to Government or equivalent
criteria.source_clause: The bidder shall have successfully completed supply of similar goods within the last 5 years.

criteria.name: Non-Blacklisting Declaration
criteria.source_clause: Bidder shall declare that it has not been blacklisted / debarred by any Central or State Government.
